meta_ai.table_note: Its self-serve version answers from your catalogue and past chats and does not connect to a CRM, stock or booking system. The enterprise platform can, with a developer and a WhatsApp Business Platform account. It starts free, with paid Meta One tiers from US$14.99 a month (Meta announcements, 3 Jun and 15 Sep 2026).
meta_ai.faq_answer: Meta's Business Agent answers from your catalogue and your past chats, inside WhatsApp, and the self-serve version does not connect to a CRM, a stock system or a booking system (Meta's announcement of 3 Jun 2026 and vendor write-ups since). If every answer your customers need lives in a catalogue, it may be enough, and it starts free. 41 Closer is run by a team, quotes from your price rules, follows up on its own, and on Pro reads live stock and writes orders and bookings back to your own systems. Meta's enterprise platform can connect systems too, but it needs a developer and a WhatsApp Business Platform account.

region.para: WhatsApp is the most-used app in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, so 41 Closer works the same way in all three: your own number, built in 48 hours, run from Singapore, billed in Singapore dollars. We have no office in Malaysia or Indonesia and do not pretend to. The agent answers in English and the mixed English your customers actually type. If your customers write mainly in Bahasa, ask us before you count on it.
region.faq_answer: Yes, where WhatsApp is the channel. WhatsApp is the most-used app in Malaysia and Indonesia, about nine in ten internet users monthly, so the setup is the same as in Singapore: your own WhatsApp Business number, built in 48 hours, run by us from Singapore, billed in Singapore dollars. We have no office in either country. It answers in English and the mixed English your customers type. If your customers write mainly in Bahasa, ask us before you count on it. In Thailand, Vietnam and the Philippines the main apps are LINE, Zalo and Messenger, and we do not build for those today.
region.sources: DataReportal Digital 2026 country reports (Nov 2025) and the We Are Social and Meltwater summaries of them. Infobip Messaging Trends 2026 via newsbytes.ph (Jun 2026). Malaysia's WhatsApp share is a 2024 figure, the latest published.
